sentence: This project studies how adipose inflammation in obesity leads to non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
This project studies how the loss of a tumor suppressor helps lung cancer evade the immune response.
This project builds drugs from leucine-rich repeat peptides and delivers them with nanoparticles to overcome barriers in anticancer therapies.
This project studies how rhythmic electrical activity in the brain can be targeted to improve cognition deficits in schizophrenia.
This project builds a catheter device that filters chemotherapy drugs out of the blood after they have acted on a tumor.
This project tries to find out how targeting the intestinal microbiota can improve cancer immunotherapy.
This project provides histology, pathology, flow cytometry and single cell analysis of murine and human specimens.
This project provides microscopy and microfluidics technologies that help investigators study cell signaling.
This project tries to find out how a chloride channel helps macrophages defend against bacterial infections and sepsis.
This project builds a platform that uses nanoliter droplets to engineer enzymes for making molecules.
This project studies how the organization of health care services and clinical decision-making affect the care received by persons with dementia.
This project builds a method and kit for preparing RNA sequencing libraries that capture all types of cell-free RNA fragmentomes.
This project studies how cardiac fibroblasts grow and change after myocardial infarction to form a fibrotic scar.
This project builds a containerized platform that makes electrophysiology data analysis easier to repeat and share.
This project uses computational and experimental methods to predict human protein interactions and design proteins that make selective interactions.
This project tests whether telling women about breast arterial calcification on mammograms changes their cardiovascular health behaviors.
This project studies whether activity trackers and computer vision can remotely monitor Parkinson's disease symptoms.
This project aims to make genomic discoveries for cancer prevention and treatment more accurate across ancestries and environments.
This project uses structural and biophysical techniques to understand how release-activated channels open.
This project studies how an acid-sensing receptor controls inflammatory responses in acidic osteoarthritis joint microenvironments.
